annotations.title: Add page numbers to a PDF

description: Number the pages of your PDFs: at the bottom or top, on one side or in the centre, and from the page and number you choose. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 5 per file.

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

position.description: Position Values: 'abajo-centro' = Bottom centre; 'abajo-derecha' = Bottom right; 'abajo-izquierda' = Bottom left; 'arriba-centro' = Top centre; 'arriba-derecha' = Top right; 'arriba-izquierda' = Top left

name: add_page_numbers
title: Add page numbers to a PDF
